4th April, 1939. 


Dear Georgie, 

Private R. Colquhoun, Durham Light Infantry, 
has been offered employment by a firm who style them- 
selves the Yen Lays Sales Company of 750-1 Hart Road, 
Shanghai. 

‘The terms of employment seem to be somewhat 
attractive as Colquhoun is offered a starting wage of 
$ 300 per month and good prospects,with a guarantee of 
repatriation to the United Kingdom. 

Before anything more is done in the matter, 
may we trouble you for a confidential report regarding 
the alleged firm whose name fails to appear both in the 
Hong list and the telephone directory.

CONFIDENTIAL

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.1, Special Branch
REPORT
No. S. B. D.
Date April 11, 1939.

Subject Letter from Mr. R.S. Heaney, H.B.M. Consulate-General
regarding Private R. Colquhoun, Durham Light Infantry
Made by D.S.I. Logan Forwarded by C Crawford

With reference to the attached letter dated
April 4th, 1939, from Mr. R.S. Heaney, Passport and
Registration Office, H.B.M. Consulate-General,
requesting a confidential report regarding a firm
styled the Yen Lays Sales Company, 750-1 Hart Road,
which is stated to have offered employment to Private
R. Colquhoun, Durham Light Infantry, at a starting
salary of $300.00 per month, enquiries have revealed
the following :-

The concern in question is named the Yen Lap
Sales Company, and not the Yen Lays Sales Company,
as stated in Mr. Heaney's letter, which deals in the
wholesale and retail sale of the coal produced by
the Esperance Coal Mine, Yen Lap, Indo-China. The
concern, which is registered as a Chinese Company
with the Chinese Maritime Customs, was established in
April 1938, and for some time occupied a sales office
at 9 Kiangse Road. The business of the Company,
however, did not prove very successful with the result
that the Kiangse Road Office was vacated and the sales
office transferred to the residence of Mrs. Eager
(British), wife of the ex-Sergeant Eager of the S.M.P.,
who is employed as Secretary of the Company, i.e.,
Lane 750, House 1, Hart Road.

The Yen Lap Sales Company was formed by certain
Chinese executives of the Wing Mao Coal Company, the
Nee Tai Shing Coal Company and the Chung Hwa Bank.

事由 英国驻沪总领事馆 R.S. Heaney 先生来信，
涉及达勒姆轻步兵团列兵 R. Colquhoun
由警司 Logan 撰写，由 C Crawford 转呈

兹就附上的英国驻沪总领事馆护照及注册办事处
R.S. Heaney 先生于1939年4月4日来信而言，该信
请求就一家名为“Yen Lays Sales Company”（位于哈同路
750-1号）的商号提供一份机密报告，据称该商号以每月
300美元的起薪向达勒姆轻步兵团列兵 R. Colquhoun 提
供职位。经查询，情况如下：

该商号名称为“Yen Lap Sales Company”，而非
Heaney 先生信中所述的“Yen Lays Sales Company”。该
商号从事批发和零售由法属印度支那 Yen Lap 的
Esperance 煤矿生产的煤炭。该商号在中国海关登记为
华商公司，成立于1938年4月，曾在江西路9号设有一
间销售办事处。然而，该公司的业务并不十分成功，结
果是江西路办事处被腾空，销售办事处迁至前上海公
共租界工部局警务处警士 Eager 的妻子、英籍人士
Eager 夫人的寓所，即哈同路750弄1号，Eager 夫人受
雇担任该公司秘书。

Yen Lap Sales Company 是由永茂煤行、尼泰盛
煤行以及中华银行的某些华籍主管人员组建的。

(2)

事由
撰写人 转呈人

据悉，Yen Lap Sales Company 拥有大量煤炭库存，
这些库存未能在冬季售出，目前储存在尼泰盛煤行位
于麦特赫斯脱路601号的堆场之一内。

现有情报表明，预计 Colquhoun 列兵将接管目前
由 Eager 夫人履行的职责，从而使后者有更大的自由
去承担更多行政职责，例如前往印度支那进行销售等
活动。

有理由相信，业主们预期 Colquhoun 的出现将
有助于给人造成该商号是一家英国公司的印象，甚至
有可能以英国公司的身份进行注册。

Eager 夫人是一名欧亚混血儿，在与前警士 Eager
结婚之前，她是葡萄牙公民。看来 Colquhoun 是通过
这位女士或她的一些朋友结识了 Yen Lap Sales
Company。前警士 Eager 受雇于四川路440号的博德
加餐厅（Bodega Restaurant），并与妻子居住在哈同路
750-1号。

邮政信箱 259，
上海。

1939年4月4日。

亲爱的 Georgie，

达勒姆轻步兵团列兵 R. Colquhoun 已收到一家自
称为上海哈同路750-1号“Yen Lays Sales Company”的
商号提供的聘用要约。

聘用条件似乎颇具吸引力，因为提供给
Colquhoun 的起薪为每月300美元，前景良好，并保证
将其遣返联合王国。

在此事进一步处理之前，能否麻烦您就这家据称
在《行名簿》和电话簿中均查无此名的商号提供一份
机密报告？

您永远的，

Bob. Heaney

致 G.W. Gilbert 先生，副警务处长。
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。
